name: Opds
description: FreeInk OPDS client core: OpdsClient orchestration (feed fetch, 401 auth handshake, token refresh, indirect acquisition, OpenSearch, publication docs) over an injected transport, plus OPDS 1.x (Atom) + 2.0 (JSON) feed parsing with language-map title resolution, authentication documents, and OAuth password + implicit (headless HTML login) flows.
notes: OPDS 1.x parsing needs expat (XML_*). The consuming project must provide an expat library on the include/link path. OAuth implicit login needs FREEINK_NET_WOLFSSL (SecureHttpClient).
